name: bacadra-tools
author: lumine-code
description: Commands and snippets for Bacadra engineering workflows.
backgroundTips: Bacadra Tools can generalize national Eurocode citations into annex-neutral tokens.

calcPath.title: CALC path
calcPath.description: Path to the calculation notebook or script opened by Open CALC. A leading ~ expands to the home directory.

fundPath.title: FUND path
fundPath.description: Path to the foundation notebook or script opened by Open FUND. A leading ~ expands to the home directory.

todoPath.title: TODO path
todoPath.description: Path opened by Open TODO. A leading ~ expands to the home directory.

ytdlPath.title: YTDL path
ytdlPath.description: Path to the download script opened by Open YTDL. Leave empty until configured.

unicodeReadmePath.title: Unicode readme path
unicodeReadmePath.description: Path to the Markdown document opened in preview by Unicode Readme. Leave empty until configured.
